title: Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model
text:
Deepseek is open-sourcing DeepInfer, the inference framework behind its fast V4.1-Flash model. The vLLM-based system cuts compute costs and energy use when running AI models. The release adds more pricing pressure on Western providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
The article Deepseek open-sources the inference engine that powers its fastest and cheapest AI model appeared first on The Decoder.
